Method of Attack: Encrypts files using the Salsa20 encryption algorithm, exfiltrates information from a compromised machine, and demands ransom for file decryption.
Deletes volume shadow copies to inhibit the victim’s ability to recover affected files.
Attack Vector: Compromising the victim's network through RDP services exposed to the internet using brute forcing techniques and leaked credentials
Leveraging CVE-2017-0213 (Windows COM Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability) for privilege escalation and lateral movement.
